The possibility of trade is what prompts their willingness to help us.''"<br />"''What help are the Senex Houses offering?''"<br />"''Logistical support. Owing to a nearby gravitic sink, as well as to space mines sown by the Nebula Front, Asmeru is not easily approached. The '''Asmeru Anomaly''' was a [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] sink located near [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The Asmeru Anomaly was a navigational hazard for unwary [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="TEA" />
